proof_body:
by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hl10 : 0 < Real.log 10 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hqpos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by rw [hq]; positivity
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by exact_mod_cast hqpos
  have hnum : 0 < q.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr hq0
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hnum.le
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < q.den := by exact_mod_cast q.den_pos
  have hqeq : (q : ℝ) = (a : ℝ) / q.den := by
    rw [Rat.cast_def, ha]; simp
  have heq : (q.den : ℝ) * Real.log 2 = a * Real.log 10 := by
    have h1 : Real.log 2 = q * Real.log 10 := by rw [hq]; field_simp
    rw [h1, hqeq]; field_simp
  have hpow : ((2 : ℝ) ^ q.den) = (10 : ℝ) ^ a := by
    have : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ q.den) = Real.log ((10 : ℝ) ^ a) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow, heq]
    exact Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by positivity)) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by positivity)) this
  have hnat : (2 : ℕ) ^ q.den = 10 ^ a := by exact_mod_cast hpow
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by omega
  have h5 : 5 ∣ (2 : ℕ) ^ q.den := by
    rw [hnat]
    exact dvd_pow (by norm_num) ha0
  have := (Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by norm_num) h5)
  omega
